pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Bg5 h6 9.Bh4 a6 10.Nd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nd2-f1-e3 with the bishop on f1 and sent the knight to b3 for a c5-square Black occupies. Rewrote plan 1 around Nc4, a4, f4 and e5; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 with the knight on f3; plan 2 rerouted the f6-knight to a6 or d7 (the b8-knight goes there). Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Be2 O-O 9.Bf4 a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4 with the bishop on f4; plan 2 played ...Na6 after ...a6. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Be2 O-O 9.Bg5 h6 10.Bh4 g5 11.Bg3 Nh5 12.Nd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White playing ...Nxg3 and rerouting the knight via f1; plans 2-3 rewritten around ...Nxg3 hxg3, Bg4 and the f5-hole. British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Classical Variation, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent knights to g3 and f5 (no route); plan 3 played ...Nbd7-f8-g6 with a rook on f8; plan 4 read c4 as a move. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6
pages.notes: Plan 3 used Nc3-a4 against d6 (it does not hit d6); plan 4 rerouted the c8-bishop via d7-e8-g6 onto its own pawn. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O Bg4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin on the f3-knight (the e2-bishop stands behind); plan 1 pushed g4 onto the bishop; plan 2 had ...Bxf3 damaging White's pawns though the e2-bishop recaptures. Rewrote overview phrase and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O Na6
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted ...Na6-c7 with the knight already on a6; plan 4 read b5 as a move. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O Na6 10.Nd2 Nc7
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the d2-knight via f1 with a rook there; plan 2 pushed ...f7-f5 through the f6-knight. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the d7-knight via b8-c6 or f8-e6 (rook on f8). Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.
